👉VIDEO INTRODUCTION:
Doston, aaj main aapke saamne America ki aisi hypocrisy rakhne jaa raha hoon jise sunkar aapke hosh ud jayenge. Puri duniya mein American media ne yeh bataya hai ki China ek evil dragon hai jo gareeb deshon ko barbaad karna chahta hai. Lekin is episode ko dekhne ke baad aapko samajh aayega ki America ke power game ke peeche kitne logon ka khoon behta hai.

Aur zara sochkar dekhiye — Venezuela, Iran aur Iraq ke paas duniya ke sabse bade oil reserves hain, lekin aaj in teeno deshon mein logon ke paas khane tak ke paise nahi hain. Ussi tarah Congo ke paas 24 trillion dollars ke natural resources hain — unke paas duniya bhar ka sona, diamond aur cobalt hai. Bolivia ke paas duniya ka sabse bada lithium mine hai, aur Libya aur Algeria ke paas 100 ton sona pada hai. Lekin phir bhi in saare deshon ki haalat itni kharab hai ki aap soch bhi nahi sakte.

Toh sawaal yeh hai ki itne keemti resources hone ke baad bhi yeh saare desh itne gareeb kyu hain? America ka in deshon ki gareebi se kya sambandh hai? Aur America apni superpower ka istemal karke puri duniya ko control kaise karta hai? Yeh kahaani hai blood, power aur geopolitics ki.
